QuestInfo.name: Mrs. Ming Ming's Cleaning Tips 1
QuestInfo.0: Mrs. Ming Ming has 30 years in managing a household. She has agreed to teach you something about what she knows. Go see Mrs. Ming Ming.
QuestInfo.1: Mrs. Ming Ming believed that even useless Rubble from Golems could become the most helpful household tools depending on how they were used. She said she'd show Alpha and Beta how if they prepared the materials.
QuestInfo.2: Alpha and Beta learned from Mrs. Ming Ming how to use Golem rubble to get stains out of laundry.

0.0: It's easy to see Golem parts as useless. After all, you can cook mushrooms and seafood. Or you can make goods out of leather or horns to sell. But it's not like you can eat or sell Golem Rubble.
0.1: But you CAN use Golem Rubble for a few things. Here, let me show you. I'm sure you'll be surprised!

yes.0: First, I will show you how to use #r#t4000962##k. If you have #r#t4000962# x 15#k, they'll be a big help with your household chores.

no.0: You need to thank me. Knowledge like this can't be bought with money.

1.0: Did you bring all the required materials?

yes.0: Actually, many people don't know about this. If you put #r#t4000962##k in with your laundry... Ta-da! All the stains are gone! There's your one weird trick, right there.

default.0: If you bring me #r#t4000962# x 15#k, I will give you a great housekeeping tip.
